name: Posteezy

sources.title: Posteezy homepage - 'post anything with no login. Free, anonymous and SEO friendly'
Posteezy - Post+ promoted post ('Get Started for $7')

requirements: Free anonymous posting: Posteezy bills itself as 'a microblogging and link sharing startup that lets you post anything with no login'
The form itself says 'You must have JavaScript enabled to use this form' - a JS-capable browser is required
Fields: Title, Body (restricted HTML), Image (one file, png/gif/jpg/jpeg, 512MB limit), comma-separated Tags
Optional Register/Login links exist for account-based posting
preparation: Post title and body copy - restricted HTML only: a, em, strong, cite, blockquote, code, ul/ol/li, dl/dt/dd, h2-h6 allowed; URLs/emails auto-link
Decide free anonymous post vs $7 Post+ promoted post
workflow: Fill Title, Body (restricted HTML), optional Image, and Tags
Submit - anonymous posting is allowed; alternatively register/login first for an account-bound post
Optionally use 'Boost Your Post' or 'Post+' ($7) for promotion; 'Guest Post' links out to collaborator.pro (third-party paid placement)
watchFor: Form requires JavaScript - headless/scripted fetches see an empty shell
Post+ ($7) and 'Guest Post' (external collaborator.pro link) are paid promotion routes - the free post is unaffected
Anonymous posts still get public URLs - the listing is a user post, not a curated directory entry
HTML whitelist is narrow - links work but rich formatting is limited
countsAsLive: The post is publicly reachable at a posteezy.com/node/<id> URL and appears in the site's post stream
unknowns: Whether anonymous posts are moderated before appearing, or appear instantly
Whether links in free posts are dofollow ('SEO friendly' is claimed by the site itself)
Whether anonymous posts expire or can be edited/deleted later without an account
